raw_segments.text: Cordelia, had you not been their father, these white flakes did challenge pity of them.
Was this a face to be apposed against the warring winds?
To stand against the deep, dread-bolted thunder, in the most terrible and nimble stroke of
To watch, poor Purdo, with this thin helm, mine enemy's dog, though he had bit me, should
have stood that night against my fire, and wass thou fain, poor father, to hovel thee
with swine and rogues for lorn in short and musty straw, alack, alack?
Tees wonder that thy life and wits at once had not concluded all.
